newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent down 6 cts in nervous, technical see-saw.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent down 6 cts in nervous, technical see-saw.

text.p: IPE Brent futures see-sawed nervously on Wednesday, shrugging off a WTI-inspired 20 cent dip to trade choppily in thin volume at around six cents down in late afternoon on Wednesday, traders said.
March IPE Brent crude was trading six cents lower at $21.08 a barrel at 1543 GMT, after sliding to $20.65 just before the NYMEX opening from $20.92 at midday.
"They came in with a much lower WTI call and people looked at the Brent arb play and hit Brent with outright selling," a trader said.
"People are selling into this. It's highly technical and volume is very thin. There's no news about. Gas oil's steady close unnerved a few people."

Traders said Brent took fright after WTI was called to open 20 to 25 cents lower on NYMEX after weekly oil inventory data from the American Petroleum Institute showed unexpectedly large rises in crude and gasoline stocks.
The February IPE gas oil contract expired 50 cents lower at $192.00 a tonne. The March contract was trading 50 cents higher at $183.25 at 1550 GMT.
Physical delivery against the expired Feburary contract will be 5,585 lots, or 558,500 tonnes. -- William Maclean, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7646.
